title: euonymus hamiltonianus var. nikoensis
intro: Euonymus hamiltonianus var. nikoensis, commonly known as Nikko Euonymus or Japanese Spindle, is a deciduous shrub native to Japan and Taiwan. This plant is valued for its medicinal and ornamental properties. The health benefits of Euonymus hamiltonianus var. nikoensis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and lignans, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative and antispasmodic effects.
